title: frank-feedback-jam-and-actionable-blueprint-2026-09-03
content:
Purpose and form factor
- One-hour feedback jam notes + immediate actionable blueprint. Not a polished signal report — intentionally rough, prioritized for speed.
- Goal: translate disparate customer quotes into a short list of small patches (<=2w), measured experiments (4–8w), and long bets (quarter+).

Raw customer threads (short vignettes)
1) "Search answers are noisy at long contexts" — SaaS search vendor reports increased hallucination when user prompts include full document dumps (~10–15k tokens). They want a simple knob to prefer conservative completions or a rerank-by-embed prefilter.
2) "Billing spikes from dev self-serve tests" — growth-stage startup ran stress tests that produced unexpected token spikes due to default 2048 max_tokens on streaming endpoints; surprised by overage.
3) "KV cache invalidation confusion in private deploy" — infra team deployed private with transient cache mismatches when model rollover happened; unclear expected behavior in docs.
4) "Console UI: rollout view missing previous canary metrics" — PMs want historical canary traces for 48–72h per rollout, current UI shows only live window.
5) "Embedding latency variability across regions" — marketplace integrator sees embeddings latency 2x in ap-southeast vs us-west for same model variant.

Quick patterns / hypotheses
- Many asks cluster around predictable patterns: safety/quality tuning, cost/transparency, observability gaps, and private deployment docs/expectations.
- A large fraction are small UX or guardrail fixes (billing visibility, default limits, rollout trace retention) that likely reduce support tickets quickly.

Microfix candidates (<= 2 weeks) — low dev effort, high CS impact
A. Billing-kill-switch for test tokens
- Problem: self-serve teams accidentally generate high usage during dev.
- Proposal: temporary dev-mode quotas and explicit "charge me" toggle for pay-as-you-go during live testing. Default OFF for accounts created in last 90 days.
- Quick metric: support tickets about unexpected billings.
- Owner: CS + product; infra change minimal (quota flag + console toggle).

B. Console: add "show previous canary windows" toggle
- Problem: missing historical canary traces.
- Proposal: expose 72h trace playback for any rollout in the console; store lightweight aggregates (p50/p95/errors) for 7 days.
- Quick metric: stakeholder satisfaction survey; decrease in rollout support asks.
- Owner: product-console + observability.

C. Private deploy playbook patch: explicit cache rollover doc and CLI check
- Problem: ambiguity about KV cache behavior across model rollovers.
- Proposal: short playbook doc + a CLI check command (private-deploy-check) that returns cache status and recommended commands.
- Quick metric: fewer support escalations for private deployments.
- Owner: private-deployments + solutions-engineering.

Measured experiments (4–8 weeks) — moderate effort, measurable impact
D. Rerank-by-embed prefilter for long-context generative flows
- Hypothesis: prefiltering with vector similarity reduces hallucination for long docs while lowering token consumption (cost win).
- Experiment: add an optional prefilter pipeline for hosted hosted-api text.generate endpoints (opt-in query param), measure correctness on customer prompt sets and cost delta.
- Success criteria: >10% reduction in hallucination rate on selected prompts with <=5% latency increase.
- Owner: applied-ml + hosted-api.

E. Region-aware embedding pool routing
- Hypothesis: route embedding calls to nearest pooled nodes with warmed model shards to reduce tail latency.
- Experiment: pilot for 3 customers in APAC; compare p95/p99 before/after.
- Owner: infra + serving-runtime.

Long bets (quarter plus)
F. Cost-aware default profiles for new accounts
- Concept: new accounts get a tiered, opinionated set of default generation profiles that bias toward batched/quantized low-cost routes and smaller context sizes.
- Rationale: reduces early-cost surprises and educates developers on cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Timeline: Q1 planning, cross-team design.

Prioritization heuristic used in jam
- Score each ask by: customer impact (1–5), time-to-fix (days/weeks), cross-team coordination burden (1–5), visibility/PR risk (1–5).
- Microfix if impact>=3 and time<=2w and coordination<=3.

Example scoring for above items
- Billing-kill-switch: impact 4, time 1w, coordination 2 => microfix GO
- Canary window playback: impact 3, time 2w, coordination 3 => microfix GO
- Rerank prefilter: impact 5, time 6w, coordination 4 => experiment GO

Unresolved questions and open risks
- How many orgs will find a dev-mode billing toggle confusing vs useful? Need UX testing.
- Prefilter pipeline could shift cost burden to embedding ops; need to model unit cost and scale.
- Console storage retention increases S3/metrics cost — finance impact to sign off.

Triage notes for CS and triage playbook
- Triage rule: if customer billing spike reported and account age <180 days => auto-escalate to "billing-dev-mode" flow; include suggested mitigation (limit tokens, enable charge toggle).
- For private deployment cache incidents, immediately collect deploy logs, model-version history, and cache-invalidation events; provide private-deploy-check first step.

Suggested next steps (concrete)
1) Product + CS sync (30m) this week to approve microfix A & B as rapid patches. Owner: Aisha.
2) Engineering spike (2d) to validate feasibility and cost for 72h canary playback and short-term retention costs. Owner: Liam.
3) Run a 6-week experiment scoping doc for rerank-by-embed; include sample prompt sets from 3 customers. Owner: Maya + applied-ml.
4) Draft the private-deploy playbook and add CLI helper to the private-deploy repo (label: docs + tooling). Owner: Diego.

Tiny UX/communication checklist for microfix rollouts
- Short console banner: "New: dev billing mode — prevents charges during active testing. Learn more."
- Changelog entry with sample steps for enabling developer testing safely.
- CS canned response templates for the two most common scenarios (billing spike, cache ambiguity).

Notes to self (loose)
- Capture 5 representative support threads and anonymize for experiment prompt set.
- Talk to finance about expected retention cost for canary playback before committing.
- Keep this doc intentionally short; follow-ups will be separate detailed RFCs.

End jam — rough capture. Keep as living note; move to "in_review" after Product sync.
